def _node(task: tuple[int, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, float, np.ndarray]) -> tuple[object, ...]:
    index, base_state, correction_action, base_descriptor, descriptor_gradient = task
    weights = _WORK["weights"]
    reference = _WORK["reference"]
    state = base_state + correction_action / weights
    frame, norms, values = constraints._constraint_geometry(state, weights)
    initial = float(np.linalg.norm(values / norms))
    projection_action = np.zeros(98)
    if initial > PROJECTION_TRIGGER:
        scaled = values / norms
        projection_action = -frame.T @ np.linalg.solve(frame @ frame.T, scaled)
        state = state + projection_action / weights
        final = constraints._scaled_residual(state, weights)[0]
    else:
        final = initial
    actual_delta_action = (state - base_state) * weights
    transported_descriptor = float(base_descriptor + descriptor_gradient @ actual_delta_action)
    supplied_descriptor = max(transported_descriptor, 0.0)
    rate, value = collocation._field(state, supplied_descriptor, weights, reference)
    numeric_eigenvalue = float(value["numeric_selected_eigenvalue_not_used_as_descriptor"])
    return (
        index, state, projection_action, actual_delta_action, initial, final,
        supplied_descriptor, transported_descriptor, rate, numeric_eigenvalue,
        int(value["selected_branch"]), float(value["selected_eigenline_gap"]),
    )

theory/n12_c2_descriptor_fiber_denominat.text:
# C2 descriptor-fiber denominator theorem

The regularized outgoing C2 equation is solved as a graph over the signed
selected eigenvalue,

`s = lambda_event(Y)`, `Y = Y(s)`.

Consequently an endpoint enclosure at fixed `s` is not an arbitrary action
ball.  It is the intersection of that ball with the exact level set

`lambda_event(Y) = s`.

Its tangent errors satisfy `D lambda_event(Y) delta Y = 0`.  Over one
descriptor step `[s0,s1]`, the exact soft factor in

`Delta = c_psi b_psi + lambda_event R`

is therefore bounded by `s1`.  Replacing it by
`s1 + Lip(lambda_event) r` admits a normal direction that is absent from the
physical descriptor fiber.

At segment 1128 this isotropic replacement is the sole cause of the displayed
`Delta` collapse.  Restoring the exact fiber leaves a strict denominator;
the remaining scalar limitation is hard-bundle wrapping.  The next proof
object is therefore a conjugated matrix/Lohner enclosure of the fixed-`s`
tangent hard bundle.

This restriction is an identity of the existing reparametrized equation.  It
does not add a selector, constraint, time direction, endpoint, or physical
parameter.

theory/n12_c2_fresh_descriptor_fiber_eig.text:
# N12 C2 fresh descriptor-fiber eigenline chart

The 1,192-segment continuation reaches the boundary of its original action
chart with all physical margins strict.  This is a proof-chart limit.  The same
retained action is therefore recentered at the final predictor tube.

The ambient action ball has one role only: uniformly certify the selected
branch, complement gap, lapse, and positive radius rate around the uncertain
endpoint.  It does not authorize arbitrary ambient motion.  Physical
propagation remains on the codimension-one fiber `lambda_event(Y)=s`, whose
tangent is `ker D lambda_event`; normal motion is fixed by the implicit fiber
graph.

At the fresh center, the action `D3` columns give the scalar, selected-to-hard,
and preconditioned hard-block first variations.  Retained mixed `D4` bounds
control their ball variation.  The chart radius is derived by increasing the
trial radius until the first eigenline/domain theorem failure, then solving for
the maximal strict feasible radius with those same outer-ball bounds.  No
validation cutoff or physical stopping rule is introduced.
